questions.prompt: Why is including 'shellcheck-clean' in a spec's acceptance criteria important?

options.a: It converts part of code review into a mechanical check that runs automatically before human review
options.b: It causes the AI model to generate code faster
options.c: It replaces human code review entirely

questions.prompt: Why does a prompt spec that simply says 'write safe Bash' fail?

options.b: 'Safe' is ambiguous and non-verifiable — the spec must explicitly name the preamble, quoting rule, forbidden constructs, and linters
options.c: AI models ignore all system prompts

questions.prompt: Why must input validation rules be explicitly stated in the prompt spec?

options.a: AI models will not include input validation on their own, and unvalidated input leads to injection vulnerabilities
options.b: Input validation is strictly required by the POSIX standard
